testSuite.name: Fixed Preference Trigger

testSuite.name: ARM 7/1 Ideal Conditions
testSuite.description: Rule 2: Meets all criteria for ARM 7/1 (horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, credit >= 720).

testSuite.name: Low Credit Score Manual Review
testSuite.description: Rule 3: Credit score below 640 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: High DTI Manual Review
testSuite.description: Rule 3: DTI above 50 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: High LTV Manual Review
testSuite.description: Rule 3: LTV above 95 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: Precedence Rule 1 over Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 vs Rule 3: High rate sensitivity should trigger Fixed30 even if credit score is very low.

testSuite.name: Precedence Rule 2 over Rule 3

testSuite.name: No Rules Apply
testSuite.description: No criteria met: horizon > 7, variable income, LTV > 80, credit < 720 (but > 640), DTI < 50.

testSuite.name: Manual Review Boundary LTV

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (sum(for x in [application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip] return if x = null then 0 else x) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">

testSuite.name: Fixed Preference Priority
testSuite.description: Rule 1: Explicit fixed preference triggers Fixed30 regardless of other factors.

testSuite.name: High Rate Sensitivity Priority
testSuite.description: Rule 1: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30.

testSuite.name: ARM 7/1 Successful Match
testSuite.description: Rule 2: Applicant meets all criteria for ARM7/1 (horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, credit score >= 720).

testSuite.name: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Rule 3: Credit score below 640 triggers ManualReview.

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: Rule 3: DTI above 50 triggers ManualReview.

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: Rule 3: LTV above 95 triggers ManualReview.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 Overrides Rule 2
testSuite.description: Rule 1 is FIRST: Even if Rule 2 criteria are met, fixedPreference=true results in Fixed30.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Overrides Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 2 is FIRST: Even if Rule 3 criteria (DTI > 50) are met, Rule 2 conditions take precedence.

testSuite.name: No Rule Applies
testSuite.description: No rules match the input criteria.

testSuite.name: ARM 7/1 Boundary Test - Horizon
testSuite.description: Rule 2: Exact boundary for horizonYears (7).

testSuite.name: ARM 7/1 Boundary Test - LTV
testSuite.description: Rule 2: Exact boundary for LTV (80).

testSuite.name: Manual Review - Multiple Rule 3 Triggers
testSuite.description: Rule 3: Multiple triggers (low credit and high DTI) result in ManualReview.

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false then d.monthlyPayment else 0))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">

      </rule>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">

        </outputEntry>

        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>

    </decisionTable>

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Success Scenario
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria for ARM 7/1: horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, and credit score >= 720.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Applicant meets the exact boundary conditions for ARM 7/1 (horizon=7, LTV=80, score=720).

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: Rule Priority: Rule 1 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 is evaluated first. High rate sensitivity should trigger Fixed30 even if credit score is very low.

testSuite.name: Rule Priority: Rule 2 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 2 is evaluated before Rule 3. If an applicant meets ARM 7/1 criteria (e.g. score 720), they should not be sent to Manual Review even if they were close to a threshold.

testSuite.name: No Rule Applies
testSuite.description: Applicant does not meet any specific rule criteria (e.g., horizon too long for ARM, but score/DTI/LTV are within safe bounds).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan != null and application.loan.amount != null and application.collateral != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.purchasePrice < application.collateral.appraisedValue and application.collateral.purchasePrice > 0 then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.purchasePrice * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100) else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income != null and application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 then ((if application.housing = null then 0 else sum([if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest, if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes, if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance, if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa, if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip])) + (if application.debts = null or count(application.debts) = 0 then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: Fixed30_Preference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_HighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity.

testSuite.name: ARM7_1_Success
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for 7/1 ARM: horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, and credit score >= 720.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_LowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score is below 640.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_HighDTI
testSuite.description: DTI is above 50.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_HighLTV
testSuite.description: LTV is above 95.

testSuite.name: Rule1_Priority_Over_Rule3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should trigger before Rule 3 (ManualReview) even if credit score is low.

testSuite.name: Rule2_Priority_Over_Rule3
testSuite.description: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) should trigger before Rule 3 (ManualReview) even if DTI is high.

testSuite.name: No_Match_Scenario
testSuite.description: No rules match: horizon too long, income unstable, and parameters don't trigger Manual Review.

testSuite.name: ARM7_1_Edge_Case_Boundary
testSuite.description: Testing boundary values for ARM 7/1: exactly 7 years, exactly 80 LTV, exactly 720 credit.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_Boundary_Credit
testSuite.description: Testing boundary for Manual Review: credit score exactly 640 (should NOT trigger manual review if other rules don't match).

testSuite.name: Rule 1 - Fixed Preference Priority
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers fixed rate, should return Fixed30 even if other rules apply.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 - High Rate Sensitivity Priority
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity, should return Fixed30 even if Rule 3 (Manual Review) conditions are met.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 - ARM 7/1 Typical Scenario
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for ARM 7/1: short horizon, stable income, low LTV, and high credit score.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 - ARM 7/1 Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for ARM 7/1 exactly at the boundaries (7 years, 80 LTV, 720 score).

testSuite.name: Rule 3 - Manual Review Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3 - Manual Review High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3 - Manual Review High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: No Rule Match - Typical Middle Ground
testSuite.description: Does not meet Rule 1, Rule 2 (due to horizon), or Rule 3.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Fails - Variable Income
testSuite.description: Fails Rule 2 because income stability is variable.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Fails - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Fails Rule 2 because credit score is below 720, but doesn't trigger Rule 3 (it's between 640 and 720).

testSuite.name: Rule 3 - Combined Failures
testSuite.description: Multiple Rule 3 conditions met (Low score and high LTV).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false then d.monthlyPayment else 0) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>=720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text><640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">

        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else (application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else if application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100)</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else ((sum([if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0, if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0, if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0, if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0, if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0]) + (if application.debts != null then sum(append(for d in application.debts return (if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0), 0)) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100)</text>

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>

      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else if application.purpose = "purchase" then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>

      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference via Boolean
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference via Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high sensitivity to rate changes.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Standard Case
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria for 7/1 ARM.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria at exact boundary values.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review via Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Applicant has a credit score below 640.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review via High DTI
testSuite.description: Applicant has a DTI above 50.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review via High LTV
testSuite.description: Applicant has an LTV above 95.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 Priority: Fixed Preference over Manual Review
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should trigger before Rule 3 (ManualReview) even if credit score is low.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Priority: ARM 7/1 over Manual Review
testSuite.description: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) should trigger before Rule 3 (ManualReview) even if DTI is high.

testSuite.name: No Rule Applied: High Horizon
testSuite.description: Applicant does not meet Rule 1 (no preference), Rule 2 (horizon too long), or Rule 3 (stats okay).

testSuite.name: No Rule Applied: Variable Income
testSuite.description: Applicant fails Rule 2 due to variable income stability.

testSuite.name: No Rule Applied: High LTV but not Manual Review
testSuite.description: Applicant fails Rule 2 (LTV too high) but does not trigger Rule 3 (LTV <= 95).

testSuite.name: No Rule Applied: Low Credit but not Manual Review
testSuite.description: Applicant fails Rule 2 (Score too low) but does not trigger Rule 3 (Score >= 640).

testSuite.name: Edge Case: Null Values
testSuite.description: Null values should not trigger any rule.
